src: 8-connected foreground sprites s ordered left-to-right; each contains one non-grey color and grey control pixels
dst: side-by-side compact sprite slots d in the same left-to-right order
transform: crop each s to its bbox, recolor grey control pixels to s.color, and paste with background transparent
multi_step: anchor the first sprite at its original top row; at each seam align the grey marker on s[k]'s right edge with the grey marker on s[k+1]'s left edge
grid_shape: height stays three rows; width is the sum of the ordered sprite bbox widths
